title: NVIDIA grew 7K employees—and is still 10K short! #artificialintelligence #nextgenai
summary: NVIDIA has expanded its workforce by 7,000 employees but continues to face a significant talent gap of 10,000 roles. This reflects the intense demand for labor in the rapidly growing AI hardware sector.

title: 66% of companies are cutting entry level jobs for AI! #nextgenai #artificialintelligence
summary: A practitioner report claims that 66% of surveyed companies are reducing entry-level job roles due to the implementation of artificial intelligence. The content suggests a significant shift in corporate hiring practices regarding junior talent.

title: I Watched 3 Companies Lay Off Their Managers. All 3 Hit the Same Wall.
summary: This article examines the common operational failures experienced by three organizations that attempted to eliminate middle management roles. It highlights the recurring bottlenecks and systemic challenges that arise when traditional oversight structures are removed without adequate replacement systems.

title: Pro Max 5x quota exhausted in 1.5 hours despite moderate usage
summary: Users are reporting rapid depletion of service quotas for the Pro Max 5x model, suggesting potential issues with usage accounting or restrictive rate limits. The exhaustion occurring within 90 minutes under moderate activity highlights concerns regarding infrastructure predictability for power users.

title: Anthropic downgraded cache TTL on March 6th
summary: Anthropic reduced the time-to-live (TTL) duration for their prompt caching feature on March 6th. This change affects how long cached prompt segments remain available for reuse in subsequent API calls.

title: European AI. A playbook to own it
summary: The article outlines a strategic playbook for Europe to establish leadership in the artificial intelligence sector. It proposes focus areas such as infrastructure investment, regulatory reform, and fostering local startup ecosystems to compete with US-based firms.

title: Tell HN: OpenAI silently removed Study Mode from ChatGPT
summary: Users on Hacker News have reported that OpenAI silently removed the "Study Mode" feature from the ChatGPT interface. This observation highlights ongoing concerns regarding the unannounced modification or removal of platform capabilities.

title: Show HN: Claudraband – Claude Code for the Power User
summary: Claudraband is a developer-focused CLI tool designed to extend the functionality of Anthropic's Claude Code. It targets power users seeking streamlined workflows and enhanced interface capabilities for AI-assisted coding.
